title: OurHome Chore Event Weekly Completion Time Trend
dataSources: Canvas assignments (`canvas:assignment`), Khan Academy SAT practice (`khan:sat`), Family Link usage (`familylink:usage`), and OurHome chores (`ourhome:chore`).
app: Canvas LMS exports, Khan Academy SAT practice, Google Family Link screen-time data, and OurHome chore tracking streamed to Splunk.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=ourhome:chore completion_minutes=*
| bin _time span=1w
| stats avg(completion_minutes) as avg_duration, max(completion_minutes) as worst_duration by _time
| sort _time
description: Trends the average and worst completion time for OurHome chore event events each week.
value: Weekly timing trends show whether a process is becoming slower, more erratic, or healthier over time.
implementation: Capture completion_minutes on each event and review weekly averages plus worst cases during your personal ops review.
visualization: Line chart of weekly average completion time with markers for the worst week.
grandmaExplanation: It frames whether OurHome chore event tasks are taking longer than they used to and where the slow weeks were.
